description:
#### Added
- **What's installed, in Settings → Updates.** The page now shows the Instagram version, the
  patch bundle, whether this is an official release or a build you patched yourself, whether
  it's the clone, and which app installed it. Long-press it to copy all of that for a bug report.
- **Notes block works on every account.** Where Instagram draws the Notes tray with Compose
  and no view id, the whole row is taken out of the inbox list instead.
- **Caption edits survive opening other posting options.** Editing a caption now saves it to
  the draft before music or story sharing opens; deliberately clearing a caption still works.

#### Changed
- **Based on Instagram 455.0.0.51.72.** All 19 patches apply to it. The post menu's option
  list moved into a coroutine dispatcher and its row adder takes an extra argument, so the
  download row and Copy caption now go in where Instagram creates the menu list; share links
  are cleaned in the share intent builder that now returns a result.
- **"Star on GitHub" in the What's new card**, replacing the Sponsor button there. Sponsoring
  is still in Settings, under Support, next to a new Star button.
- **Following feed only joins the permanent lock.** Once the lock is on, the ranked feed
  cannot come back without reinstalling.
- **Tablets and large screens.** The tab bar is found on the side rail too, so hiding Home
  and the settings long-press work there, and the settings open again on a long press.

---

Oxbow for Instagram 455.0.0.51.72 (patch bundle 1.3.3). Earlier patch bundles for this
version, and what they changed: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

- **oxbow.apk** replaces Instagram (uninstall Instagram first).
- **oxbow-clone.apk** installs next to Instagram.
- **patches-1.3.3.mpp**: patch Instagram yourself in [Morphe Manager](https://morphe.software): add the source `github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow`.

Obtainium: add `https://github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow` and set the APK filter to `oxbow\.apk$` or `oxbow-clone\.apk$`.

```txt
af88dc98eb40499a3b48551745cae3340216e46771c5d821e0202b50eb663f6a  oxbow.apk
bea0b7e9dbf0c308a0b8d73061443121849a2b3b9de29c935b400c041303a6c7  oxbow-clone.apk
5f782aa8a166de944642873c0235703a4549f8d386600d41bfbce7ee482b88d1  patches-1.3.3.mpp
```

patches.name: Clean share links
patches.description: Strips Instagram's tracking parameters (igsh, utm_*...) from links you copy or share.

patches.name: Clone
patches.description: Renames the package and app label so the patched build installs alongside a stock Instagram instead of replacing it.

options.description: A new package name for the patched app.
A new app name (label). Entering "Instagram" skips changing the label.

patches.name: Comments and endless scroll
patches.description: Optional comment blocking (no comment button, no comment sheet), no swiping to the next reel in reel viewers, and the story viewer's swipe-up gesture does nothing. Runtime toggles.

patches.name: Debug bridge
patches.description: Development only: exposes the Oxbow settings over ADB broadcasts so they can be driven from a shell instead of the on-screen panel.

patches.name: Download media
patches.description: Adds Instagram's native Download item to every post's menu and saves the original photo or video (current carousel slide) to Pictures/Oxbow or Movies/Oxbow.

patches.name: Feed item filtering
patches.description: Drops sponsored posts, ad/promo and suggested feed units at the JSON-parse layer, catching the ones injected inline into the timeline that URL blocking misses. Gated on the Ads and Suggested toggles.

patches.name: Force SDR display
patches.description: Reroutes Instagram's window colour-mode changes so the app can be pinned to SDR, keeping the dark UI's blacks deep instead of the washed-out look HDR forces.

patches.name: Ghost mode
patches.description: Optional: watch stories without being listed as a viewer, read DMs without sending read receipts, type without showing "typing...", screenshot disappearing photos and videos without the sender being told. Each is a runtime toggle.

patches.name: Hidden Home in Back history
patches.description: Leaves the app on Back from the first tab shown when the Home icon is hidden, instead of walking back onto the hidden feed.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI
patches.description: Removes Meta AI and Muse from the share sheet, quick-promotion cards and the "About this reel" summary with its Ask Meta AI box; its feed units (Vibes, Meta AI chats, Imagine) are dropped by the feed item filter. Gated on the Meta AI and Muse toggle.

patches.name: Install-packages permission
patches.description: Declares REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES so the update dialog can download and install a new release directly instead of opening the browser.

patches.name: Limit feed to following profiles
patches.description: Optionally restricts the home feed to accounts you follow, by rewriting the feed request's pagination header. Gated on the runtime toggle.

patches.name: Network content blocking
patches.description: Blocks the feed, stories, explore, reels, ads, suggestions and tracking at the network layer, gated on the runtime toggles.

patches.name: Notes tray
patches.description: Lets the Notes block take the Notes tray out of the Direct inbox's list, for the accounts where Instagram draws it with Compose and no view id to hide.

patches.name: Oxbow icon
patches.description: Replaces the launcher icon with the Oxbow mark (adaptive, with a monochrome layer for themed icons).

patches.name: Popup hiding
patches.description: Drops Instagram's popups ("Couldn't refresh feed"), which a blocked surface raises on every failed request. Gated on the Instagram popups toggle.

patches.name: Preserve post caption
patches.description: Saves caption edits directly to the current post draft before opening music or story options.

patches.name: Restart relay
patches.description: Declares the one-shot activity Oxbow runs in its own process to bring Instagram back after the cache-clear restart.

patches.name: Settings entry point
patches.description: Opens the Oxbow settings on a long-press of the Home tab, and installs the surface hiders and update check.

patches.name: Signature check bypass
patches.description: Forces Instagram's signing-certificate trust checks to always pass, so a re-signed APK is treated as an official Meta build and deep links route to their content instead of falling back to the home feed.

patches.name: Suggested accounts in the story tray
patches.description: Drops the suggested accounts Instagram mixes into the story tray, gated on the Suggested accounts toggle.
